summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.4 and Codex models are being integrated into Cloudflare's Agent Cloud platform to let enterprises build, deploy and scale AI agents.

mechanisms.reason: The partnership explicitly enables enterprises to build and deploy tool-using AI agents for real-world tasks.
mechanisms.quote: enabling enterprises to build, deploy, and scale AI agents for real-world tasks with speed and security

mechanisms.reason: Scaling enterprise agent deployment implies increased aggregate inference calls, though no volume figures are given.
mechanisms.quote: build, deploy, and scale AI agents for real-world tasks

categories.reason: Cloudflare's Agent Cloud is the hosting platform onto which OpenAI's models are being deployed for enterprise agent workloads.
